calculator101.title: 101 Calculator Privacy Policy
calculator101.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how the developer ("we", "our", or "us") of the mobile application <1>101 Calculator</1> ("App") handles your information when you use our App.
calculator101.intro2: 101 Calculator is a mobile application offering AI-powered object detection and score calculation for 101 Okey game. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring a safe experience.
calculator101.intro3: By downloading, installing, or using the App, you agree to the handling of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.
calculator101.section1Title: 1. Information Collection and Use (No Direct Data Collection)
calculator101.section1Text: We do not collect, store, or transfer any personal data directly to remote servers.
calculator101.section1Text2: We do not require account registration or personal information (such as name or email address) to use the App. All calculation history and preferences are stored solely on your device.
calculator101.section2Text1: The App accesses your device camera upon your permission for 101 game tile/score detection:
calculator101.section2ListItem1: <0>Purpose of Use:</0> Camera permission is strictly used to run live Object Detection and perform image analysis.
calculator101.section2ListItem2: <0>100% On-Device Processing:</0> Live camera frames are processed in temporary device memory (RAM) in real-time.
calculator101.section2ListItem3: <0>No Saving or Uploading:</0> Camera feeds or photos are never sent to remote servers, uploaded to the internet, saved, shared with third parties, or stored on your device.
calculator101.section3Text: AI models used in the App operate 100% on-device using your processor. No data is sent to cloud AI services for object detection or calculations. The App functions completely offline.
calculator101.section4Text: To keep the App free, we use Google AdMob for advertisements. Google AdMob may collect device data according to its own privacy policy:
calculator101.section4ListItem2: Device identifiers (such as Android Advertising ID / iOS IDFA)
calculator101.section4Footer: You can manage ad tracking via your device Settings. For details on Google's data usage:
calculator101.section4Link2: How Google uses information from sites or apps
calculator101.section5Title: 5. Legal Disclaimers and Limitation of Liability
calculator101.section5AText: The App is provided on an <1>"AS IS"</1> and <1>"AS AVAILABLE"</1> basis. The developer does not guarantee 100% accuracy or uninterrupted operation of object detection or score calculations.
calculator101.section5BText: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the developer shall not be liable for any calculation errors, game score disputes, device overheating, battery consumption, data loss, or third-party ad content.
calculator101.section6Text: You agree to hold harmless and indemnify the developer against any claims arising from your use of the App or violation of this policy.
calculator101.section7Text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes become effective when posted on this page.
